answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the zephyr is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the reef is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
